data.bottom_line: With snow on the ground and more piling up, it's time to start thinking about avalanches. If you’re out hunting or hiking, you are as susceptible to avalanches as a skier or snowmobiler. When in doubt, stick to low-angle slopes. We’ll start issuing avalanche forecasts in December, as dictated by conditions. In the meantime, we’ll continue issuing periodic conditions updates like this one.
